description: A $2,500 merit award for a sophomore or junior who served in an Overseas Contingency Operation and is studying a C4I-related STEM discipline.
eligibility_text: Must have served in an Overseas Contingency Operations (2003-present) and provide a DD214 or Certificate of Service verifying deployment. Must be a sophomore or junior at the time of application; freshmen and seniors are not eligible. Must have a minimum overall GPA of 3.0. Must be a U.S. citizen. Must be currently enrolled at an accredited four-year U.S. college or university, part time or full time, in a C4I-related STEM discipline.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them.
